episodes.title: Showing My Survivor Art Paintings #survivorstory #shinyhappypeople
episodes.description:
Hello,
Welcome to my channel. On this channel, I will be telling my story of being raised in an abusive cult and what that has looked like in my life after I left. Hard things will be discussed. The cult I am referencing is ATI/IBLP.  That is The Advanced Training Institute or The Institute of Basic Life Principles. Started and run by Bill Gothard. This is the cult discussed in the Amazon Documentary series, Shiny, Happy People. 
The purpose of this channel is to claim my voice, own my story, inspire others, encourage others, and help others escaping know that they are not alone.

@Sewingistherapy
